out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED VARIOUS FORMS OF RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL ON PREMISES.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC REMOVED PEST CONTROL FROM PREMISES DURING INSPECTION. FACILITY HAS A CONTRACT WITH PEST CONTROL COMPANY. PLEASE ENSURE RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL IS NOT USED AT RESTAURANT.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: SEAWEED manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS SHOULD NOT BE REUSED BECAUSE THEY ARE NOT NSF APPROVED AND ARE NOT MADE TO BE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED REPEATEDLY. PLEASE GRADUALLY DISCONTINUE USE OF THESE CONTAINERS AND REPLACED WITH NSF-APPROVED CONTAINERS.
